subject: AWS Marketplace: Clarify Listing Claims & Support SLA Wording
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia@amazon.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: aws-marketplace-technical@amazon.com
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing - support SLA & claims questions

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for submitting the Redwood Inference listing draft. We're doing a quick compliance pass and have a couple of questions so we can move the listing to Certification: 

1) Branding/claims: In the product description you state "low-latency, enterprise-grade inference with 99.99% availability" and include the Redwood logo in three places. We need clarification on the availability claim (marketplace policy requires substantiation for uptime claims) and confirmation you have rights to the logo variants used.

2) Support SLA wording: The listing currently says "24/7 support with guaranteed response times" and points to a general contact email. Marketplace policy requires specific severity definitions, response time windows, and escalation paths (or a link to a signed SLA). Please provide the exact SLA text you intend to publish.

3) Third-party integrations: There's a short section referencing "native integrations with AWS KMS and S3"—please confirm the integration names and provide any partner references.

Can you send a clean copy of the final product description plus the proposed public-facing SLA (PDF/Doc) and brand guidelines for the logos you used? If you can share a redline or a short checklist of changes you plan to make, that will speed Certification.

Attachment: marketplace-checklist-template.csv (see referenced checklist fields)

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a 30-min call if easier.

Best,
Lydia
Amazon Web Services - Marketplace Certification
(attachment: marketplace-checklist-template.csv)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Marketplace listing - support SLA & claims questions

Vanessa / Marissa — looping you in. AWS cert wants cleaned-up copy and a public SLA. Quick asks:

- Vanessa: can you confirm logo variants are covered under our brand policy and attach the brand pack we share externally?
- Marissa: can you draft the public-facing SLA text that is tight enough for Marketplace but accurate to what we offer for Hosted vs Dedicated customers? Call out severity definitions, response times, and any exclusions.

Notes from Lydia: no unsupported uptime % without backup metrics; they want either documented uptime evidence or dial back the language to something we can substantiate. They also asked for an explicit escalation path (names/emails/phone numbers).

I attached our current marketing description and the sandbox listing text (attachment: redwood_listing_draft.txt). Please track changes in the doc and return by Monday so I can reply to Lydia.

Thanks — J
--
Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0113
(attachment: redwood_listing_draft.txt)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Marketplace listing - support SLA & claims questions

Quick pass below — I redlined and attached: redwood_brand_guidelines_v1.pdf. High-level:

- Branding: we own the logo variants; approved external pack attached. Do not use the stacked icon in the footer of listing (AWS prefers clear space around the mark).
- Claims: drop "99.99%" from the public description for the Hosted offering. We can claim "industry-leading low latency" and publish measured median p95 latency ranges by model family in a separate metrics section. If they insist on an availability percentage, we can provide a Verified Availability statement for Dedicated customers with committed uptime in our Dedicated contracts (but that requires a separate Marketplace product entry).
- SLA language: I drafted a consumer-facing SLA that distinguishes Hosted vs Dedicated. Hosted: 24/7 support via ticket with P1 (system down) response within 1 hour during business hours and 4 hours outside business hours; Dedicated: 24/7 phone + email, P1 response within 30 minutes. I avoided absolute uptime % claims in the public doc. See proposed_sla_language_v2.docx (attached).
- Escalation: we can provide an escalation path but should not publish direct phone numbers for engineers. Recommended: a designated support email, Tier 2 on-call contact (managed by CS), and account manager contact for billing/escalation.

I'll also attach support-matrix.xlsx showing support tiers by plan.

If Marissa is good with tone/accuracy, Jonas you can respond to Lydia with these attachments and offer a 30-minute call.

Vanessa
Senior Manager, Partnerships & Alliances
Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood_brand_guidelines_v1.pdf) (attachment: proposed_sla_language_v2.docx) (attachment: support-matrix.xlsx)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Park <lydia@amazon.com>
Cc: aws-marketplace-technical@amazon.com, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 21:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Marketplace listing - support SLA & claims questions

Hi Lydia — thanks for the clear list. We attached the items requested and outlined our intended public wording below. Happy to join a call if you'd like to walk the doc.

Public product description (final) — short form:
"Redwood Inference — enterprise inference runtime optimized for low-latency, cost-efficient LLM serving. Supports model hosting, private deployments (VPC), and integrations with AWS KMS and S3. Backed by 24/7 support for Dedicated customers; hosted customers receive ticketed support with defined severity response times."

Public SLA excerpt (attached: proposed_sla_language_v2.docx) — highlights:
- Hosted offering: ticket-based support. P1 (service unavailable): response within 1 business hour (Mon–Fri 8am–6pm PT), 4 hours outside business hours. P2: response within 1 business day.
- Dedicated offering: 24/7 phone + email support, P1 response within 30 minutes.
- We do NOT publish a blanket 99.99% availability claim for Hosted. For Dedicated customers we can provide a contractually-backed availability commitment (not part of the public listing text).
- Escalation path: support@redwood.ai (Tier 1), a managed on-call team for Tier 2 (internal contact shared via Account Manager), and the AM email for billing/escalations. We will not publish direct engineer phone numbers.

Attachments included: redwood_brand_guidelines_v1.pdf, proposed_sla_language_v2.docx, support-matrix.xlsx

Next steps: please confirm if the wording above meets Marketplace Certification guidance or if you need uptime evidence or additional partner references for the AWS KMS integration. If acceptable, we can update the listing tonight and request a re-review.

Thanks,
Jonas
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood_brand_guidelines_v1.pdf) (attachment: proposed_sla_language_v2.docx) (attachment: support-matrix.xlsx)
